LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - NOTICE WAS GIVEN TO THE OTHER PARTY AFTER THE TENTATIVE RULING CAME OUT. THE MATTER WAS ARGUED. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: CROSS-COMPLAINANT FAIR MARKET PROPERTIES, L L C'S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE FIRST AMENDED CROSS-COMPLAINT IS GRANTED ON THE CONDITION THAT F M P NOT OPPOSE A MOTION TO CONTINUE THE TRIAL DATE AND/OR REOPEN DISCOVERY IF ONE IS MADE BY ASCARRUNZ DUE TO THE NEW ALLEGATIONS IN THE FIRST AMENDED CROSS-COMPLAINT. SINCE THE ASSIGNMENT AGREEMENT IS CENTRAL TO THE PARTIES' DISPUTE, INTERESTS OF JUSTICE REQUIRE THAT FMP BE PERMITTED TO ALLEGE A CLAIM FOR BREACH OF THAT AGREEMENT AND THERE IS NO LEGAL PREJUDICE TO ASCARRUNZ BY GRANTING SUCH PERMISSION ON THE AFOREMENTIONED CONDITION. THE COURT ALSO GRANTED MR. ASCARRUNZ WITH 15 CALENDAR DAYS LEAVE TO FILE A RESPONSE TO THE AMENDED CORSS-COMPLAINT. COURT TO PREPARE FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: HAROLD KAHN, REPORTER: LAVENA WARD CSR # 7077 301/HEK
